---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

Teams |>
	group_by(yearID) |>
	summarize(
		total_home_runs = sum(HR),
		total_team_games = sum(G)
	) |>
	ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = total_home_runs)) +
	geom_line() +
	labs(
		title = "Total home runs by season",
		x = "Season",
		y = "Total home runs",
		caption = "Source: Lahman database"
	)
```
